meta.objective: Implement the missing V4 paper-audit execution path: package registry, package-aware runtime, local source acquisition, target import builders, and package-aware canary harnesses for Gilardi and Zheng, leaving only live Convex import and experiment/job creation calls.

decisions: Use a paper-audit package registry instead of encoding target fidelity only in experiment metadata.
Support faithful Gilardi and Zheng execution by extending parser families instead of rewriting the stage engine.
Keep all target acquisition local under _local/ and stop before live Convex bundle application.
